## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal changed faster than the configured percentage relative to its own recent history. Speed of degradation, not absolute level.

Query:

```
pct_change(avg(last_10m),last_30m):sum:trace.span.errors{__SCOPE__} by {service}.as_rate() > 300
```

## Impact

The service still functions but measurably worse; a subset of traffic or users is failing.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-app-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `auto-enrich-change` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `deploy_events_window`, `terraform_runs_window`, `servicenow_changes_window`.

Attached to the alert automatically: every deploy, Terraform apply and change record in the last 2h.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `sre` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `platform-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P2, P3 — ack within 10 minutes, escalate at 20.
